name: scene3d_apply_actor_choreography
description: Apply one shared full-take choreography to multiple people. Use this instead of calling scene3d_get_actor_motion/scene3d_generate_actor_motion per person. The server reads all actor state once, owns fresh ETags, converts relative routes around each actor, validates collisions, generates and commits each result, then returns the terminal status for every target. Omit actorIds to target every placed person. A large crowd can exceed one request: when the response carries notAttemptedActorIds, call this tool again with exactly those ids and the identical choreography — they were never started. This controls only actors and their roots, never props. @see guides_get('scene3d')

actorIds.description: Optional exact actor ids. Omit to apply the choreography to every placed person.

choreography.description: Ordered shared cues. They whole-replace every selected performance and must total exactly the take duration. Routed cues precede at most one final unrouted cue.

durationSeconds.description: 2–10 seconds in 0.5s steps. Required for an in-place cue. With a route, use it to make the cue occupy an exact interval; do not combine with travelSpeedMps.

prompt.description: English physical behavior shared by every person. Controls only the person; never claim prop pickup, opening, holding, attachment, exact contact, gaze, or synchronization.

relativeWaypoints.description: Optional x/z offsets in world units from each actor rest position, in order. The same offsets preserve the formation; do not pass absolute world coordinates.

travelSpeedMps.description: Optional routed-cue alternative to durationSeconds. The server derives the exact 0.5s duration.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this generation. Reuse the same key only to retry the same call; a new generation needs a new key.

shotId.description: Exact take id from scene3d_state cameraPath.
